items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new company news. Direct fetch of elcogen.com/category/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest post (28 days old). Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new company news. topsoe.com/press-releases still features the H1 2026 half-year statement and the e-methanol Sweden contract win as its newest items; no new SOFC/SOEC-specific release found (53 days since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results / March 2026 SOEC pathway reset).
Today's dedicated rotation — new cycle 3, round 1 (Bloom Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, FuelCell Energy, Mitsubishi Power), 7-day lookback: No new items for any of the six.

Bloom Energy: results were evergreen SEO analysis (enkiai.com) or the already-logged Oct 22 earnings-date release and an April 2026 "hiking 2026 revenue outlook" story (re-verified dated April 29, 2026, not new).

Ceres Power: results were enkiai.com SEO-aggregator analysis and the already-logged Sept 30 "Total Voting Rights" RNS / H1 2026 results (£22.8M H1 revenue, narrowed loss, £102.6M equity raise) — no new disclosure.

Sunfire: German-language coverage (solarserver.de, chemie.de, h2-international.com, cleanthinking.de) all re-confirms the already-logged SOEC test-facility construction start at BASF Schwarzheide (dated August 2026) — not new.
SolydEra: Hannover Messe 2026 PMX-platform coverage remains already-logged; a SolydEra–Dynelectro 1 MW SOEC partnership item is confirmed dated November 22, 2024 — not new.

FuelCell Energy: the "FCEL Q3 loss wider than expected" story (Zacks/Nasdaq) is confirmed dated September 9, 2026 — fiscal Q3 2026 results already logged ($33M revenue, -29.4% YoY; adjusted loss $0.67/share incl. $17M Fit Energy charges; backlog $1.3B committed / $2.4B awarded). Not new.
Mitsubishi Power / MHI: SOEC test-module coverage remains the already-logged item; no new dating found.

Rotation sweep 1 — Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Weichai: No new items. Reverion's $175M/€150M Series B coverage (evertiq.com, Oct 2) is recirculated coverage of the already-logged Sept 29 announcement. Weichai/Ceres manufacturing-licence and Convion/Wärtsilä items are 2023-vintage.

Rotation sweep 2 — Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries: No new items. Results were entirely enkiai.com SEO-aggregator pieces or pre-2026 stories (an SK ecoplant/GDS Singapore SOFC story is confirmed dated September 4, 2023).
Other key players (Kyocera, Aisin, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC): not in today's rotation; no items surfaced incidentally.
